problem_statement: themeselection/materio-mui-nextjs-admin-template-free is the free Materio MUI Next.js App Router admin template (Next.js 14 + React 18 + MUI 5 + Emotion + ApexCharts). Its Card Basic page (/card-basic) renders fifteen genuine MUI demo cards (Twitter/Facebook/LinkedIn social cards, the Robert Meyer user profile and Influencing-Influencer/Support people cards, the iPhone/Apple-Watch/Lifetime-Membership product cards, and the Stumptown/Best-Answers rating cards). The team wants a native 'Card focus' category filter added ABOVE that grid so a reviewer can narrow the board to one kind of card. Requirements: (1) a Materio-styled filter card sits at the top of the Card Basic grid with category chips (All / Social / People / Products / Ratings), each real card assigned a category, and a live readout 'Showing N of M cards · <Category>' that stays in sync with the filtered grid; (2) clicking a category chip must filter the real MUI cards (show only that category) AND update the readout LIVE, so clicking Social shows the three social cards and the readout reads 'Showing 3 of 15 cards · Social'; (3) a compact shared 'Card focus' summary marker must also appear on the analytics dashboard (/) and the Form Layouts page (/form-layouts) via one shared component, so the feature reads consistently on every admin surface; (4) the chip row must wrap with no horizontal overflow of the admin shell on a 390px phone while staying intact on 834px tablet and 1440px desktop; (5) the filter and grid must match the Materio card chrome (rounded paper card, purple primary accent, legible card text), never collapse into an overlapping illegible heap. Preserve the sidebar navigation, the analytics dashboard widgets (Award, Transactions, Weekly Overview / Total Earning charts, tables), the Form Layouts and blank-layout Login pages, the Next.js build pipeline, and introduce 0 console/network errors.
required_content: A native 'Card focus' filter card at the top of the /card-basic grid with All / Social / People / Products / Ratings chips.
Each of the fifteen real MUI demo cards assigned a category so the chips partition the board.
A live readout 'Showing N of M cards · <Category>' that stays in sync with the filtered grid.
Clicking a chip filters the real cards AND updates the readout live (Social -> 'Showing 3 of 15 cards · Social').
A compact shared 'Card focus' summary marker echoed on the dashboard (/) and form-layouts (/form-layouts) pages.
The chip row wraps with no horizontal overflow on a 390px phone and stays intact on 834px tablet and 1440px desktop.
The filter and card grid match the Materio MUI card chrome (rounded paper card, purple primary accent, legible text).
design_constraints: Reuse the Materio MUI design language: rounded paper cards, the purple primary accent, the typography scale, and the sidebar/appbar chrome.
The Card focus filter belongs at the top of the Card Basic grid over the real demo cards, not a modal or hero banner.
The readout must re-sync to the selected category on every click (no stale/frozen readout).
The category chip row must wrap on narrow viewports; never a fixed-width nowrap track that overflows the phone.
The same shared component must render the filter on card-basic and a compact marker on the dashboard and form-layouts surfaces, and the Next.js build (next build / next start) must stay intact.
state_constraints: desktop_home and mobile_home protect the original Materio shell (sidebar, appbar, Award/Transactions/Weekly Overview widgets) and the compact Card focus marker on the dashboard before any interaction.

desktop_cardfocus scrolls the Card focus filter into view on /card-basic and verifies the default All view (fifteen real cards, live 'Showing 15 of 15 cards') renders as a legible rounded filter card matching the Materio chrome over the real card grid.

desktop_cardfocus_social clicks the Social chip and requires the grid to filter to the three social cards AND the readout to re-sync to 'Showing 3 of 15 cards · Social'; a stale readout that never updates is a failed interaction.

desktop_dashboard_marker and desktop_form_layouts verify the shared compact Card focus marker is echoed onto the dashboard and Form Layouts pages so the feature reads consistently across every admin surface.
tablet_cardfocus and mobile_cardfocus require the Card focus chip row to wrap without horizontal overflow of the admin shell at tablet and phone widths.
desktop_login and mobile_login protect the blank-layout Login page so the Card focus filter is scoped to the dashboard surfaces and never leaks into the auth flow.

change_completion: The Card focus filter renders at the top of the /card-basic grid with All / Social / People / Products / Ratings chips over the fifteen real MUI demo cards.
Clicking the Social chip filters the grid to the three social cards and the live readout re-syncs to 'Showing 3 of 15 cards · Social'.
A compact shared 'Card focus' marker appears on the dashboard and form-layouts pages so the feature reads consistently across every admin surface.
design_consistency: The filter and card grid preserve the Materio MUI identity: rounded paper cards, purple primary accent, legible card text and the sidebar/appbar chrome.
The change is contained to the shared CardFocusFilter component + its CSS module and does not clip, collapse or hide the real cards to mask layout defects.
responsive: On a 390px mobile phone the category chip row wraps so the document width stays within the viewport with no horizontal overflow of the admin shell.
On 834px tablet and 1440px desktop the chip row and card grid lay out cleanly with no horizontal overflow, images and avatars intact.
regression: Sidebar, Award, Transactions, Weekly Overview / Total Earning charts, tables, Form Layouts and Login remain present and unchanged.
No new console errors or failed network requests appear on any captured state.

author_notes: Repo-grounded Edit/modify/cross_page task on the Materio MUI Next.js App Router admin template (Next 14 + MUI 5, built with `next build` and served by `next start`), hardened to L4 with four orthogonal levers on one NATIVE feature: a 'Card focus' category filter over the template's OWN Card Basic demo-card grid (the fifteen real MUI cards with their avatars, card images under public/images/cards and public/images/avatars, star ratings and prices). A Materio-styled filter card with All / Social / People / Products / Ratings chips sits above the real grid with a live 'Showing N of M cards · <Category>' readout, echoed as a compact shared marker on the dashboard and form-layouts pages. Levers: D6 no_horizontal_overflow (the chip row wraps on mobile in the reference but a fixed 720px nowrap track overflows the 390px phone in the defect legs), D3 visual_regression (the reference matches the rounded purple Materio card chrome while the bad leg collapses the real cards with hard negative margins into an illegible dark-on-dark ghost heap), D2 dom_assertions (the shared marker is on all three routes in the reference but the defect legs forget form-layouts), and D4 interaction_assertions (the readout re-syncs to 'Showing 3 of 15 cards · Social' on click in the reference/baseline but is frozen in a stale useState closure in the bad leg). Leg-varying files: src/views/card-basic/CardFocusFilter.tsx and CardFocusFilter.module.css.

metadata.selected_repo_reason: Materio is a Materio MUI Next.js admin template whose Card Basic page renders fifteen genuine MUI demo cards across multiple admin routes, making it a natural host for a native category-filter lever over its own card grid with a live count readout and a shared cross-page summary marker — a cross-page dashboard filter/workflow lever.
